claims.text: Role in Paget dz: bone turnover is ↑, so ensure adequate Ca and vitamin D; supplements are often needed.
claims.quote: Because bone turnover is increased, patients should ensure adequate intake of calcium and vitamin D, and supplements are often needed.

claims.text: Ca gluconate = 90 mg elemental Ca per 1 g; Ca carbonate = 400 mg per 1 g.
claims.quote: 1 to 2 g of elemental calcium/day may be given as calcium gluconate (90 mg elemental calcium/1 g) or calcium carbonate (400 mg elemental calcium/1 g).
